# RS Anime

> Free anime streaming site for series, movies, donghua, cartoons, and latest episode updates.

RS Anime is a public anime streaming website focused on fast playback, Hindi dubbed content, English subtitles, multi-audio support, and daily episode updates.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Main discovery page for anime, movies, ongoing releases, and featured content.
- [Search](/search): Public search experience for finding anime titles.
- [Notifications](/notifications): Public updates and release notifications.
- [About](/?page=about): About RS Anime and service details.
- [Privacy Policy](/?page=privacy): Privacy and data-use details.

## Optional
- [Telegram Channel](https://t.me/cartoonfunny03): Official channel for release updates and announcements.
